steps.content: The battle is over. Hella stares at the defeated attackers blankly. Among them is one in white armor that's filled with contamination.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's the FAC team. Looks like they came here after the contamination outbreak and died here eventually.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Poor things... How did they end up like this? Didn't they each have a contamination shield?
The contamination shield only provides limited protection. It resists contamination by depleting Hypercubes, and Hypercubes are hard to come by.

036 comes near you. He goes down on one knee, next to Soldier 702, who is lying close to you. Soldier 702's helmet has been shattered, revealing the young face underneath. He detested you, but he didn't think twice before taking a fatal blow for you.
Stop... the Black Ring... Must stop it...
We will.

036 reaches out to pull on a security ring on the inside of Soldier 702's armor, and removes a Hypercube contamination shield from the chest of the armor. As soon as he's done so, Soldier 702 stops breathing.
The pain on his face dissipates, and his pupils start enlarging. His captain closes his eyes.

Physical trauma can affect one's mental state. He was no longer able to resist the mental contamination here. He died in a human form; this way, I could at least recover the Hypercubes inside the Mania shield.
This is valuable.
036 has recovered four blue crystals, which he puts on your palm. He is the sole survivor in his team, but his face is untouched by even a shadow of sadness.

options: ...This is the kind of rationality required by the FAC too?

steps.content: Yes. Mind suppression is fundamental to the FAC's fighting. To resist Mania, you must have an extremely rational mind. Losing control of your emotions only brings contamination.
This can help the MBCC too. It can be trained. It can help you become accustomed to responding to emergencies.

options: Including the death of your fellows?

steps.content: Yes. Deaths are part of the game. If you can't accept this, you don't deserve to fight for the FAC.

options: So that's why you can stay emotionless

steps.content: Yes. I'm a member of an FAC combat unit. To fight Black Rings, I can discard all emotions.
Just now you asked me whether I would force your hand if you refused to get involved in the battle.

If forcing your hand means my success in killing Zoya, then I will. But the problem is, the shackles' power comes from your will, so if you have no desire to fight yourself, there is no point in forcing you to.

We protected you because of that glimmer of hope, that you might be identified with our fight and join us in our endeavor. This is all too sudden, too much for you to handle; then again, one can only hope.
Even if you choose not to join us, we're still moving on with our mission. This is our duty; we must continue, even if it's a losing battle that we're fighting.
He raises his eyes. The conference hall looms ahead, behind which stands the grand Statue of Keylan, overrun with fast-spreading contamination.
The DisCity is spurned for its many sins, but it's our only home nevertheless. Our city was never built on peace.

The world was plagued by Mania calamities back then. Without Hypercubes, humans had no choice but to hole up in refuges, not knowing what tomorrow would bring. The DisCity's prosperity was built by our many ancestors with their wisdom, determination, and even lives.
But that prosperity is very fragile. It can be taken away by a simple Black Ring. And that great man who went into the mire of despair to retrieve the seeds of hope is long gone.
Now, only we can protect this city. It rose amid a hellish landscape, and we will not let it fall without a fight.
The FAC is giving it all it's got, to fight Mania and safeguard the DisCity. So what's your choice?
You don't have a quick answer. As he's said, this is all too sudden, too much for you to handle. But there is one thing you can be sure of.

options: Move along. Go meet with Zoya

steps.content: I'm gonna find the answer myself.
Then... at least we can keep each other company. I'll do whatever it takes to keep you safe.
That's for the sake of that glimmer of hope I cling on to. I hope you'll eventually make up your mind and decide to help us prevent the Black Ring.
As if answering your resolve to march ahead, a multitude of contorted monsters is crawling out of the contamination mist that envelops the conference hall.
